action.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.type = 'Revenue' THEN gl.credit - gl.debit WHEN a.type = 'Expense' THEN -(gl.debit - gl.credit) ELSE 0 END) AS net_income FROM gl_lines gl JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = gl.account_id WHERE gl.entity_id = 'US01' AND gl.period = '2026-04' AND a.type IN ('Revenue', 'Expense')
